annotations.text:
Aurora on white — blue dominant, orange as punctuation.
Blue #3986e4 and orange #cc6600 share oklch L 0.62 / C 0.16, so neither overpowers the other.

A (Editorial) is the leading direction: Instrument Serif + Space Grotesk.
B and C are alternates — pick one and I'll build it out in full.

Two alternates, same palette, different stance:
B · Index — JetBrains Mono, all 11 projects as a scannable table. Engineer-forward, least decoration.
C · Immersive — Syne display, work as an overlapping mosaic. Most memorable, least scannable.
Thumbnails are real frames pulled from your 11 project videos (2.5s in). On the live site these stay video, playing on hover.
